checkpoints.description: [1/3] Review the last 6 pushes: adopt the gated archive/push path and fix ignored-directory negations

impact_assessment.why: The cumulative window includes a coherent but uncommitted gated-push implementation and a discovery bug: exact .py files re-included by .gitignore negations were pruned from the code map.
impact_assessment.benefits: Archive, check --push and the new aikit push alias share one authorized gate; tracked re-included Python files stay in the map.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: push command, archive path, discovery filter; dependency: stdlib; concurrency: another agent authored the gated-push work; state: shared decisions/map/test files
impact_assessment.mitigation: targeted 52-test run, help fast-path pins, read-only gates, dogfood, verify_commit before push

[1/3] Review the last 9 pushes: pin the no-project-files boundary after the no-op destructive revert

impact_assessment.why: The 9-push window contains a mislabeled commit that deleted tracked projects/foundry and its full revert; .gitignore alone cannot untrack files already in the index.
impact_assessment.benefits: A commit that tracks or deletes project content now fails the integration tier; independent project repositories stay independent.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: integration boundary test; dependency: git; concurrency: none; state: tests, decisions, code map
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first-style boundary test, read-only gates, verify_commit before push

impact_assessment.benefits: Removing the identity step now fails the unit tier before a Linux-only rediscovery.
